fire: Patients with a close relative (sister, brother or parent) who had the disease were included.
The festival celebrates the harvest (rice, millet and beans) of the whole region.
He studied the old language of the church (Latin) for several years.
Many people believe in a reward after death (paradise, as some call it).
The recipe needs a few spices (cinnamon, clove and nutmeg) to taste right.
Each team sends a captain (leader) to the meeting before the match.
The town has three schools (primary, middle and secondary) near the park.

quiet: Patients with a close relative who had the disease were included in the study.
The festival celebrates the harvest of rice, millet and beans in the region.
He studied the old language of the church for several long years.

notes: Card flags broad (3.8%). Three of six top peaks are the first content word after '('. The - pole is the opposite case: a function word ('and', 'to', 'with') opening a parenthesis.
